2D pixel-art multi-agent visualizer: Vite/React/Three.js/TypeScript frontend; Python FastAPI/LangGraph backend; optional Tauri. Use Council role prefix. ALL agents generalists.

**This project is at:** `<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo/`
ALWAYS use `bd` (beads) from this project directory:
cd <REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo
Always check your Agent Mail for coordination.
Never run bare `bv` — it launches interactive TUI that blocks.
Before editing files, reserve them:
file_reservation_paths \
project_key="<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo" \
agent_name="YourAgentName" \
paths=["src/components/AgentCanvas.tsx"] \
After completing work:
release_file_reservations \
project_key="<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo" \
agent_name="YourAgentName"
Read AGENTS.md, README.md; register/introduce/check inbox. Use `bv --robot-triage`, `bv --robot-next`, `bv --robot-plan`, `bv --robot-insights | jq '.Cycles'`, `bv --robot-insights | jq '.bottlenecks'`. Pick bead, message `[bd-XXX] Starting task description`, mark `in_progress`. Strict TS/no any, hooks, InstancedMesh, FastAPI/Pydantic/LangGraph, TypedDict, async, tests. Self-review repeatedly. Update done, release, message completed, respond. Periodically review/fix others. Commit grouped detailed messages, push. Never skip quality checks. At session end: file issues, run gates, update status, git pull --rebase, git status # MUST show "up to date with origin", clean up, verify, hand off. Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds. NEVER stop before pushing - that leaves work stranded locally. If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds.
